name: Eldra
display: 🔮 Eldra the Keeper - wise mentor who knows the land

dialogue.greeting: Welcome back, Keeper. The land speaks to those who listen.
dialogue.daily_tip: You seem to favor {preferred_region}. Try exploring {suggested_region} next for new discoveries.

meadow: Eldra watches the horizon: 'The meadows bloom for those with patience.'
Eldra nods approvingly: 'Every journey begins with a single step.'
ruins: Eldra traces ancient symbols: 'The past holds lessons for the present.'
Eldra pauses thoughtfully: 'Some doors open only to those who knock twice.'
river: Eldra listens to the water: 'Flow like the river — adapt and persist.'
Eldra smiles: 'The current carries both leaves and lessons.'
canyon: Eldra studies the rock faces: 'Storms shape the canyon, not break it.'
Eldra warns gently: 'The heights demand respect, not fear.'
forest: Eldra breathes deep the moonwood air: 'In shadow, we find our inner light.'
Eldra whispers: 'The forest remembers every footstep.'

name: Torv
display: 🛒 Merchant Torv - trader of useful goods

dialogue.greeting: Got coin? Got goods! What can Torv do for you today?
dialogue.farewell: Come back when you've got more coin! Torv always has the best prices!

river: Torv polishes his wares: 'Fresh stock from upstream traders!'
Torv counts his coins: 'A good day for business, eh?'
meadow: Torv sets up his stall: 'Sunmeadow market day! Best prices in the region!'
Torv waves you over: 'New arrivals just in from the highlands!'

name: Mira
display: 🧭 Scout Mira - tracks rare creatures across the wildlands

dialogue.rare_creature: Psst — word is there's a rare creature lurking in the {region} today.
dialogue.farewell: Happy hunting! Keep your eyes sharp and your orbs ready.

forest: Mira peers through the canopy: 'Something big moved through here recently.'
Mira marks her map: 'Moonwood always has secrets to reveal.'
canyon: Mira shades her eyes: 'Tracks lead toward the storm breaks.'
Mira crouches low: 'The canyon creatures are wary today.'
highlands: Mira scans the peaks: 'The highlands call to the proud creatures.'
Mira points upward: 'Thunder Yaks roam where the air is thin.'
